parameters.subject: Application Received – Confirmation
parameters.message: =Dear {{ $json.candidateName }},  Thank you for applying to join our organization.  We have successfully received your application and resume. Your application is now recorded in our recruitment system and will be reviewed by our recruitment team.  We appreciate your interest in the opportunity. If your profile matches our current requirements, our team will contact you regarding the next steps.  Thank you for your time and interest.  Best regards, Recruitment Team

parameters.subject: Application Update – Shortlisted
parameters.message: =Dear {{ $json.candidateName }},  We are pleased to inform you that your application has been shortlisted for further consideration.  Our recruitment team has reviewed your application and would like to proceed with the next stage of the recruitment process. Further details regarding the interview or next steps will be shared with you separately.  Please keep an eye on your email for upcoming updates.  Congratulations, and thank you for your interest in joining our organization.  Best regards,   Recruitment Team

parameters.subject: Application Update – Recruitment Decision
parameters.message: =Dear {{ $json.candidateName }},  Thank you for your interest in joining our organization and for the time and effort you invested in your application.  After careful consideration by our recruitment team, we regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward with your application for this position at this time.  We appreciate your interest and wish you the best in your future career endeavors.  Best regards,   Recruitment Team
